prompt: Write consolidate.py in the repository root exposing consolidate(paths) -> list[dict]. It reads the JSON Lines order files at the given paths, in the order given, and returns every order exactly once, keeping the reading order. A redelivered file means an order can appear again in a later file and must not be returned twice. Do not change the order records themselves.

order_id is not unique on its own
